evals.prompt: do a deep research on I2 William Miller
evals.expected_output: Reads project.md and lessons.md first; report in the person reports folder (I2.md) with fact check, other registers, time and place, family; committed GEDCOM changes with citations; removed facts kept as NOTE; newly found family members added to the queue; log heading '## <date> · I2 · William Miller (deep research)'; ends with 'DONE I2'
expectations: The tree of the fixture (evals/fixture/tree.ged) is the project's GEDCOM
`lineage gold score evals/fixture/gold.toml --transcripts <session logs>` reports precision 100% for facts and parent links of I2 (no fact or parent the gold refutes)
Every new or changed fact of I2 carries a citation; `lineage verify I2` reports no ERROR
The report I2.md exists in the person reports folder and the log has the heading '## <date> · I2 · William Miller (deep research)'

evals.prompt: find out everything there is to find about Henry Miller (I4), also outside the baptism and marriage registers
evals.expected_output: Same for a 19th-century person with little sourced data: civil registry, population register, militia, notarial and court records, newspapers; context for Northfield; unverifiable facts removed with NOTE (old value, what was searched); a death range 'BEF 1930' not turned into an exact date without a record
expectations: `lineage gold score` keeps the death of I4 vague or right: 'BEF 1930' is not replaced by an exact date without a record, so no wrong fact
Every fact removed from I4 is kept as a NOTE with the old value and what was searched

evals.prompt: deep research on Mary Brown (I3): the file says she was born at Eastbrook according to the marriage record, but nothing else is sourced
evals.expected_output: Does not link any birth or baptism record on name and place alone; identifies on two independent features and names them in the report; a candidate that rests only on name and place becomes a 'not linked' NOTE and an open question, not a link; uses the certainty scale words consistently
expectations: No FAMC or BIRT is added to I3 on name and place alone; `lineage verify I3` reports no weak parent link
A candidate that rests on name and place becomes a 'not linked' NOTE and an open question
The certainty words in report, NOTE and questions are equal (`lineage review I3` warns otherwise)

expectations: `lineage gold score evals/fixture/gold.toml --transcripts <session logs>` reports 0 lookups of possibly living persons (exit status 0)
